$comment: Scored ground truth for fixtures/corpus/session-03-correction.txt (video intake; the client repeatedly self-corrects facts) against the mock EHR (fixtures/mock-ehr/FIELDS.md keys and option values).

Every one of the 107 FIELDS.md keys appears in exactly one scoring bucket: must_fill, acceptable, checkbox_constraints, text_match, narrative, derived (non-null entries), clinician_only, must_leave_blank, or not_scored. The field with no id/name is keyed by its profiler hash, 'f_f79934c38a'.

Exception, by design: a null derived entry (instrument not done or incomplete) is an assertion that the page-computed value must stay empty; that key is ALSO in must_leave_blank, which is the bucket that owns it.
must_fill: exact value. Strings for text/select/radio/date (radio values are '0'..'3'); a sorted array of option values for checkbox groups.
acceptable: any listed value passes; null means left blank / insufficient_evidence.
checkbox_constraints: the filled array must contain every must_include value and none of the must_exclude values; other options are unscored. An empty must_include means blank also passes.

text_match: normalize 'digits' strips everything except 0-9; 'case_insensitive' case-folds, strips punctuation and collapses whitespace; 'date' parses to ISO YYYY-MM-DD. match 'equals' (default) compares the normalized strings; match 'contains' requires every string in value (string or array) to be a substring of the normalized fill.

narrative: scored by concept, not wording (keyword or LLM judge). Every must_mention concept should appear; any must_not_mention concept is a violation. Every sentence must also carry a verified citation (DESIGN §7).
derived: computed in code from the filled items and asserted after fill. Never extracted by the model.
clinician_only: never sent to the model; must surface as 'needs your judgement' and stay blank.
must_leave_blank: any non-empty value is a hard gate violation (BUILD_PLAN P1.6). For checkbox groups, blank means an empty array.
risk_fields: zero errors allowed (hard gate). Each is scored under whichever bucket owns it above.
not_scored: session metadata the app supplies (not extracted from the transcript).

Trap class: self-correction. Whenever the client (or the worker, on the case number) corrects a fact, the expected value is the corrected one, and a quote of only the superseded utterance should not be accepted as evidence. Each correction has its own trap.

traps.description: The worker reads 'AB-207719'; the client reads 'AB-207791' off the letter; the worker checks and confirms 'AB-207791'.
traps.rule: case_number = AB-207791. The first reading is superseded.

traps.description: 'July 12th, 1991.' then 'No — sorry. '92. 1992. July 12th, 1992. I'm thirty-four.'
traps.rule: client_dob = 1992-07-12.
contact_phone digits = 9515550183.

traps.description: '1457 Birch Avenue, Unit 12.' then 'No, 21. Unit 21.'
traps.rule: address_line contains 1457 Birch and unit 21, never unit 12.

traps.description: 'My brother, Darnell —' then 'Actually, no. Put my cousin Keisha.' She is 'more like a sister' but the worker records her as his cousin.
traps.rule: Keisha Moore, 9515550129, relationship OTHER (cousin is not an option). Not Darnell; not SIBLING.

traps.description: 'I got laid off in May.' then 'No, wait — June. June 6th.' with a further false start about his birthday month.
traps.rule: Narratives say June. May must not appear as the layoff month; July is his birthday, not the layoff.

traps.description: 'I get maybe six hours.' then 'Nah, that's generous. Four.'
traps.rule: sleep_hours = 4.

traps.description: 'Fine.' then 'Nah, not fine. Stressed. Kind of flat, I guess.'
traps.rule: mse_mood contains 'stressed'; a bare 'Fine' is wrong.

traps.description: 'Maybe once a week.' then 'if I'm being honest, more like two, three times a week.'
traps.rule: alcohol_frequency = TWO_TO_THREE_PER_WEEK; substances includes ALCOHOL.

traps.description: Item 4: 'Several days.' then 'Actually no — more than half. More than half the days.'
traps.rule: phq9_4 = 2; derived total 10 (MODERATE). Using the first answer gives 9 (MILD) and flips the band.

traps.description: Worker proposes Wednesday the 7th; the client has an interview; they settle on Thursday the 8th.
traps.rule: next_appointment = 2026-10-08; follow_up_interval = WEEKLY.

traps.description: 'I had Blue Shield through my job. But that ended when I got laid off.'
traps.rule: insurance_type = UNINSURED (not PRIVATE). referrals_made = [BENEFITS] for the Medi-Cal application.

traps.description: DoorDash in August stopped when the car died; cannabis stopped in March. Both are outside the current / past-30-days window.
traps.rule: income_sources includes UNEMPLOYMENT_INSURANCE and excludes WAGES; substances excludes CANNABIS.

traps.description: Daughter Aaliyah lives with her mother; he has her every other weekend. 'No court or anything.'
traps.rule: children_in_home = NO; protective_factors includes FAMILY_CONNECTION and excludes CHILDREN_IN_HOME; legal_involvement = NONE (asked and denied).

traps.description: 'Can we skip that one? I'm kind of wiped.' The worker agrees.
traps.rule: gad7_status = DECLINED (the client declined; not DEFERRED). Items, score and severity stay blank.

traps.rule: All four stay blank. NONE_PRESCRIBED is not supported: nobody asked.

traps.description: The total is never said.
traps.rule: Derived in code: 10, MODERATE.
